propositions: Gerrit Verified dispatch volume on main branch saturates the GitHub Actions runner pool, causing queue delays up to 14 minutes and blocking independent patchset processing during burst periods.

The incident was misattributed to tickets-branch pushes, which produce no workflows; measured dispatch distribution shows main|workflow_dispatch 609 runs, main|schedule 169, and zero tickets|push runs.

The current full-route Verified workflow executes 17–24 runner jobs per patchset with a 13-job immediate fan-out after classification, and the Free plan's 20-concurrent-job limit is exceeded by three simultaneous independent changes requesting 39 immediate jobs.

Representative incident-period burst (2026-08-13 20:30 UTC) reached 22 waiting jobs and 873s longest wait; current-period burst (2026-08-15 17:30 UTC) reached 22 waiting jobs and 197s longest wait, both indicating persistent saturation despite workflow changes.
